prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:

If you prefer to do it yourself, here are fast, reliable ways to find a qualified tester and what to check for:

How to find someone
- Ask the City of Liberty Utilities / Public Works or your water district for their list of approved/certified testers — many utilities maintain or require an approved list.
- Search for “backflow tester Liberty MO” or “backflow testing Liberty MO” (also try nearby Kansas City).
- Call local plumbers, irrigation companies, or fire-protection contractors — many are certified to test/repair backflow assemblies.
- National plumbing franchises (e.g., Roto-Rooter, Mr. Rooter) often provide testing in metro areas.

What to verify before hiring
- Certification: the tester must be a certified backflow assembly tester in Missouri (confirm their tester number or certificate).
- Experience with your specific assembly (reduced pressure, double-check, etc.).
- Proof of insurance and any required business licenses.
- They will provide a written test report and, if required, file results with your water utility.
- Ask whether they handle repairs or will subcontract — if repairs are needed, get a written estimate.

Typical costs (approximate)
- Testing: commonly $50–$150 per device depending on device type and region.
- Repairs: highly variable — from small parts/labor (~$100–$300) to major repairs or replacement ($500+).
